keywords: Certiorari – State land – Long occupation – Application for regularization only in 2015 – Earlier quit proceedings – First petitioner previously agreeing before Magistrate to vacate premises – Valid permit issued to competing claimant following Land Kachcheri in 2013 – Subsequent re-entry/challenge – Delay and laches of approximately two and a half years – Failure to pursue claim at Land Kachcheri – No merit – Notices refused without costs. S. Thurairaja PC J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; State-land permit and Land Kachcheri framework; State Lands (Recovery of Possession) legislation is relevant to the quit proceedings, though the short order does not identify a particular section.
